style: loka style A, 1.5x at 4x density (1 sprite px = 1 CSS px at P=4)

proportion_template.feet_line: anchor row = bottom of the frame

keying: background = pixels near #FF00FF that are connected to the image border (flood fill), plus enclosed pure magenta pockets (r>190, b>190, g<80) as see-through gaps; 1 px magenta despill on the edge; no global colour key
swap_rule: recolour palette entries whose palette_regions label is skin/hair/shirt/pants (businessman: skin/hair/suit/shirt/tie): target hue and saturation from lookFor, lightness offset from region_defaults kept; hair lightness floored at 0.3 so it does not merge with the outline
hand_rule: hand accessories (briefcase) pin their pivot (top centre of the handle) to accessory_anchors[view].hand; on walk frame k add hand_walk_offsets[view][k] and draw the accessory on the layer hand_walk_layers[view][k] ('over' = after the body, 'under' = before the body). Every frame uses the tracked hand: front = viewer-right hand, back = viewer-left hand (both the character's left hand), side = the near hand. When that hand is hidden behind the body (back view, arm swung forward) the point is interpolated along the swing, pushed in until the handle is covered by the body, and the layer is 'under'. No head-bob fallback.
